title: Fynkel document envelope
description: Fields every Fynkel authoring document carries (blueprint §6, ADR-0006). Kind schemas extend this with allOf and add their body.

editorNotes.description: Free-form notes; the JSON has no comments (blueprint §6).

uuid.description: Canonical lower-case UUID; the persistent identity of documents, entities, components and assets.

typeId.description: Namespaced type id such as fynkel.Transform or game.PlayerController.

assetRef.description: Reference to an asset by identity, never by path.
